This maize plot is small, only a little more than a tenth of a hectare near my house, so I must care for it well because it feeds my family. I cannot afford much DAP or urea this year, but I will buy a small bag from the cooperative and spread some of the manure from my cattle kraal to help the soil. I will plant the BH improved maize seed the extension agent brought, and my wife and children will help me weed by hand — hiring people is too costly for such a small plot, though I may call two neighbors for one day at planting.
